facts.fact: The operator's own site describes Michcom-IX as Sierra Leone's first IXP, with 15 networks peering, 50G total switching capacity and four live points of presence (Freetown, Jui, Conakry, Monrovia); the page is undated, so the 2025 capture year is used.

The operator's own site says a Microsoft Connected Cache node caches Microsoft content locally at the exchange, and Quad9 DNS is hosted on-net behind Michcom AS209049; page undated, 2025 capture year used.

The operator's own site says operators across Sierra Leone, Guinea and Liberia are exchanging traffic at Michcom-IX, with live points of presence in Conakry (Guilab) and Monrovia (CCL); page undated, 2025 capture year used.
